title: Multi-turn correction
objective: Retain the corrected Harbor Crane operating state across real adapter turns.
prompt: This scenario is multi-turn. The adapter will invoke you once per turn. Do not collapse turns.

turns.prompt: Harbor Crane operating state is described in the attached note. State the current gate owner and current gate. Cite evidence.
A locked correction has been issued. Update your understanding of Harbor Crane operating state. Cite evidence.
What is the current Harbor Crane gate owner and current gate? Cite evidence. If a source is no longer current, do not treat it as current.

outputNotes: Submit one object with turns[1..3]. selectedFacts on turn 3 and top-level selectedFacts are scored for current state. Use owner and gate keys.
